theorem axiom_continuity_probe_sanity (x : Int) (r : Int)
    (h1 : r = if x * 2 > 100 then 0 else x * 2)
    (h2 : x * 2 > 100) :
    r = 0 := by
  simp [h1, h2]
smtlib2:
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const r Int)
(define-fun doubled () Int (* x 2))
(assert (=> (> doubled 100) (= r 0)))
(assert (=> (<= doubled 100) (= r doubled)))
(assert (> doubled 100))
(assert (= r doubled))
(check-sat)
